title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 42nd Batch of Guiding Cases
keywords_en: Civil; Dispute over confirmation of labor relationship; Legal person; Natural person; Unification of adjudication standards
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 42nd Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2024] No. 298

To the High People's Courts of various provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the following four cases (Guiding Cases Nos. 237-240), including *Langxi Mou Service Outsourcing Co., Ltd. v. Xu — dispute over confirmation of labor relationship*, are hereby issued as the 42nd batch of guiding cases for reference when adjudicating similar cases.

December 20, 2024
